title: Presentation and challenge session
outcome: Explain presentation and challenge session using the records and boundaries of this fictional investigation.
scenario: Answer a challenge without inventing evidence. At the presentation, a reviewer asks whether the model works on a different camera.
given: The project tested twelve photos from camera A only. Ten were correct; no camera B records exist.

steps.label: Address the challenge
steps.detail: Say camera B performance is not measured.

steps.label: Propose a valid next test
steps.detail: Use reserved camera-B cases with labels, grouping and a fixed scoring rule.

explanation: A challenge session tests whether the team knows its evidence boundary. An honest unknown plus a specific future test is stronger than an unsupported confident promise.

counterfactual.change: The reviewer shows one camera-B success.
counterfactual.prediction: That is one demonstration, not an estimate of broad camera-B reliability.
counterfactual.reason: One selected observation does not represent the full proposed condition.

student_task: Answer the camera-B challenge using only the twelve camera-A records. Why is one displayed camera-B success a demonstration rather than broad evidence of camera-B reliability?
teacher_answer: Report 10/12 correct on camera A. Say camera B performance is not measured. Use reserved camera-B cases with labels, grouping and a fixed scoring rule. Changed case: That is one demonstration, not an estimate of broad camera-B reliability. One selected observation does not represent the full proposed condition.
project_evidence: For the Reproducible AI Research Study, retain an annotated worked trace and the changed-case reasoning. Connect the claim to its records, units and assumptions so another investigator can challenge or reproduce it.
limits: The original result and proposed study still need sampling and uncertainty discussion.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice distinct from the reserved independent case. No invented significance, real experiment execution or pupil outcome is asserted.
